First postoperative progress note:
Surgery time: 07 h 31 min to 13 h 56 min
Intraoperative diagnosis: 1. Coronary heart disease, post CAG+PCI, severe mitral regurgitation, cardiac function class Ⅲ (NYHA) 2. Multiple small nodules in both lungs; hepatic cysts 3. Atherosclerosis of bilateral carotid and lower limb arteries with plaque formation
Anesthesia method: General anesthesia with intubation
Surgical procedure: Mitral bioprosthetic valve replacement via right chest + epicardial temporary pacing electrode implantation
Brief surgical course: The heart was enlarged; the mitral valve leaflets were thickened, contracted; opening not restricted; closure incompetent.
